metric: Prefix recovery AUROC, pooled inherited vs recovered
positive: all TEST positions with Step=0 and Prefix=1
negative: TEST positions with Step=0 and Prefix=0 after an earlier retained Prefix=1 in their trajectory
aggregation: pool across trajectories; no same-trajectory pair restriction or per-trajectory averaging
score: frozen selected detector final Prefix probability
selection: reuse original VAL-frozen configurations; no new selection, training, model inference, bootstrap or threshold tuning
best_baseline_rule: highest published overall Prefix TEST AUROC per domain, not recovery AUROC
